newsitem.title: USA: News Corp names Echostar in counterclaim.
newsitem.headline: News Corp names Echostar in counterclaim.

text.p: News Corp Ltd said on Monday that it filed counterclaims against EchoStar Communications Corp over a failed $1 billion merger proposal which would have offered up to 500 channels of digital TV, internet services and local broadcast TV signals to U.S. markets.
News Corp said it denied all the material allegations in EchoStar's complaint, such as breach of contract and accused EchoStar of bad faith, misconduct and failure to disclose material information.
EchoStar was not immediately available for comment to respond to News Corp's allegations.

News Corp also accused EchoStar's chairman and chief executive officer of putting his interests in retaining control over EchoStar ahead of the interests of News Corp, News Corp's ASkyB satellite unit and EchoStar shareholders.
